title.narrative: Advancing Afghan Women's Economic Empowerment

description.narrative:
The overall objective is to enhance human capacity development of Afghan women.

The Specific Objectives are:

To improve higher education and outgoing learning mobility system for Afghan women graduates.

To enhance employability opportunities for Afghan women participating in the outgoing learning mobility programme.
